name: heatmap-chart
title: Heatmap chart
description: A year of activity lights up week by week, then the camera leans in on the busiest day.

props.name: data
props.doc: Counts: one array of seven days (Sunday first) per week, oldest week first.

props.name: startDate
props.doc: Date of the first cell, YYYY-MM-DD (a Sunday).

props.name: unit
props.doc: What a count counts, for the tooltip and the subtitle.

props.name: palette
props.type: primary | monochrome | ocean | sunset | grove | vivid
props.doc: Chart palette: primary (indigo, yellow, fuchsia, mist, black), monochrome, ocean, sunset, grove or vivid.

props.name: sweepSeconds
props.doc: How long the camera takes along the weeks.

props.name: holdSeconds
props.doc: How long the last frame holds on the tooltip.

props.name: camera.lag
props.doc: Seconds the camera trails the wave of light.

props.name: camera.motionBlur
props.doc: Strength of the motion blur on the fast moves; 0 turns it off.

props.name: camera.rackFocus
props.doc: Blur in pixels on the axis labels while the shot is tight.
